subject.title: [Bug]: /context detail shows ~62k untracked provider/runtime overhead on fresh OpenAI Codex gpt-5.5 session

question: How should OpenClaw define and display Codex context-ledger buckets when Codex reports a large delta beyond OpenClaw-tracked prompt text?
rationale: The code can expose more buckets, but only maintainers can decide which Codex-reported values are context-window occupancy, billing/cache accounting, native thread state, or unknown residual before those values influence diagnostics or compaction wording.

options.title: Require live Codex ledger proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a live Codex OAuth run that validates bucket names, confidence tags, and billing-versus-window semantics before changing behavior.

options.title: Relabel residual only
options.body: Make a narrow wording change that calls the delta unknown Codex/provider residual without changing compaction or status semantics.

options.title: Trust Codex total as occupancy
options.body: Treat Codex `totalTokens` as authoritative context occupancy everywhere, accepting the risk of misclassifying cache or hidden runtime accounting.

recommendation.title: Require live Codex ledger proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require a live Codex OAuth run that validates bucket names, confidence tags, and billing-versus-window semantics before changing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent recently maintained the same `/context detail` diagnostics surface and landed the compactable transcript count fix that partially overlaps this issue.
